pricing.title: Transparent Pricing
pricing.description: Choose by freshness grade and the nearest location.

sdgs.title: Together for a Better Future
sdgs.subtitle: ByCatch Loop supports 5 Sustainable Development Goals that align with our mission.

14.title: Life Below Water
14.description: Reduces discard mortality by giving by‑catch economic value, while recording non‑target catch volumes.

12.title: Responsible Consumption & Production
12.description: Turns biomass that would be thrown away into feed and fertilizer raw material (waste valorization).

2.title: Zero Hunger
2.description: Small-scale fishers earn extra income from catch that used to have no value.

8.title: Decent Work & Economic Growth
8.description: Helps downstream small businesses (maggot farmers, silage and fertilizer makers) get a steady supply.

13.title: Climate Action
13.description: Estimates the methane emissions avoided from marine biomass rotting on the coast.
